title: Font is blurry after config migration to toml
body:
After migration to toml using `alacritty migrate`, the fonts on my terminal look terrible. They were fine before upgrading to the latest version and being forced to migrate. Here's how it looks:
![image](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/assets/35728385/b6387987-1263-4c4c-b83c-338ee7ad3c68)
Also, trying to select text causes the wrong text to be selected. Again, it worked perfectly in the previous version.

Here's my current config file:

comments.body: is it blurry regardless of font size or the size is just small? Maybe making it larger improves things.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
Here's the output of `WAYLAND_DEBUG=1 alacritty --print-events`: [Alacritty-25372.log](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/files/13786439/Alacritty-25372.log)

And it's always blurry, no matter what the size of the font is.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: could  you please add `WAYLAND_DEBUG=1` you're still missing it, it's on `stderr` not stdout, so you have to redirect.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: Seeing the same thing in v0.13.0 (Fedora 39 KDE) on first open which is to reduced window - like the resolution is off.  Maximize the window and the resolution is restored.  Restore/reduce the same window and it is still correct.  Something seems to be skewing the resolution of the window on first opening,

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: As I said, without a `WAYLAND_DEBUG=1 alacritty --print-events` and telling which resolution and scaling are you using I can't help with anything, and I'm 99% sure that it's a bug in KDE.

comments.body:
Could someone try this patch:

```diff
diff --git a/alacritty/Cargo.toml b/alacritty/Cargo.toml
index 44b048b2..8e0de57a 100644
--- a/alacritty/Cargo.toml
+++ b/alacritty/Cargo.toml
@@ -40,7 +40,7 @@ serde_json = "1"
 serde_yaml = "0.9.25"
 toml = "0.8.2"
 unicode-width = "0.1"
-winit = { version = "0.29.7", default-features = false, features = ["rwh_05", "serde"] }
+winit = { git = "https://github.com/participant1/winit", branch = "wayland-fix-request-over", default-features = false, features = ["rwh_05", "serde"] }

 [build-dependencies]
 gl_generator = "0.14.0"

```

And post the same logs I've asked from it regardless whether it worked or not?
